say:1:1322218001:1.text: Was it Lady Carolina who instructed you to assist? Good. I've been monitoring the deterioration of His Lordship's portrait frames, and I require your help to address the matter promptly.
say:1:1322218001:1.source_cn: 你们是卡列琳娜小姐邀请来帮忙的？太好了，我正为画框保养...

say:2:1322218002:1.text: I am responsible for the daily upkeep of Lord Ludovic's artworks, but the materials required for maintaining the portrait frames are now exhausted. Without immediate action, the frames will inevitably decay.
say:2:1322218002:1.source_cn: 我经常会为子爵先生做一些艺术品的日常保养，可是保养画框...

say:3:1322218003:1.text: My current responsibilities do not permit me to step away, so I must delegate this task to you. I trust you'll handle it with the urgency it requires.
say:3:1322218003:1.source_cn: 而我不便离开这里，只好麻烦几位了。

say:4:1322218004:1.text: The task requires plant oils derived solely from natural sources, preferably with a mild, natural fragrance. Be advised that Lord Ludovic has very specific preferences in this regard, and any deviation will not be tolerated.
say:4:1322218004:1.source_cn: 保养需要一些植物油脂——记住，一定要从天然的植物中提取...
